name: Evolving agent teams beat production GPU kernels
title: Evolving agent teams beat production GPU kernels
summary: Evolving Agent Teams uses a supervisor that creates specialized agents when a coding run gets stuck and keeps earlier lessons in shared memory. With a longer token budget it writes a GPU kernel 1.2x faster than production FlashInfer on 36 of 47 workloads, and 3.44x faster than FlashKDA on another kernel task on NVIDIA B200s.

appearances.title: Evolving Agent Teams: a supervisor that reorganizes its coding agents writes a kernel 1.2x faster than FlashInfer
appearances.summary: A supervisor keeps rebuilding its agent team around whatever is blocking progress, spawning debugging, profiling or exploration agents and keeping lessons in shared memory. With an extended token budget it produced a GPU kernel 1.2x faster than the production FlashInfer baseline (better on 36 of 47 workloads) and a 3.44x speedup over FlashKDA on B200s.
